subject: MAP: Security acceptance runbook + target close dates (SOC 2, SIG, DPA, retention)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: security@finovo.com, jane.doe@finovo.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: security acceptance runbook + target close dates

Hi Jane / Finovo security team,

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Per our mutual action plan (MAP) call, attaching a working MAP workbook that lays out the evaluation milestones we recommended for Finovo’s pilot and production signoff. For clarity I pulled out the security/compliance gates we expect to be part of the acceptance path:

- SOC 2 report review (latest + control mapping)
- SIG/CAIQ questionnaire responses + any clarifying follow-ups
- DPA signature with explicit retention windows and subprocessor list
- Data retention policy alignment for log/windowed call data (hot/warm/cold)
- Evidence handoff plan and ownership (who provides what)

Attachments: MAP_Finovo_v3.1.xlsx, Redwood-SOC2-Report-2027.pdf

Proposed timeline (still flexible):
- May 2–5: Finovo completes SIG workbook (we can provide an answered baseline)
- May 6: Redwood sends SOC 2 control mapping & gap notes
- May 9: Legal/DPA redline exchange; target to finalize DPA the week of May 13
- May 20: Evidence handoff completed; production enablement gate decision

Ask: can your security team confirm the internal owner for SIG responses and whether Finovo needs our prefilled SIG as a starting point? Also confirm any procurement milestone constraints (DocuSign cadence).

Thanks — happy to jump on a short sync if helpful.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
(attached: MAP_Finovo_v3.1.xlsx, Redwood-SOC2-Report-2027.pdf)

From: security@finovo.com <security@finovo.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: jane.doe@finovo.com, aaron.liu@finovo.com
Date: Wed, 2 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: security acceptance runbook + target close dates

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the MAP and the SOC 2 report. A few quick items from our side:

1) We have a security lead assigned (Aaron Liu, aaron.liu@finovo.com) who will own the SIG worksheet and technical evidence collection.
2) Procurement (Jane) owns the DPA/contract cadence but legal will run the redline.
3) Two immediate clarifications:
   - Data retention: we need to confirm the retention period for request logs and full request payloads. Our baseline policy requires 90 days for payloads and 12 months for aggregated logs; anything longer needs explicit justification.
   - Subprocessors: please provide the current subprocessors and whether any are in APAC (we have tighter controls).

We attached our SIG starter file with a few questions marked. Will aim to return completed SIG by EOD May 5.

Attachments: Finovo-SIG-Questions_v1.xlsx

Regards,
Finovo Security
security@finovo.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 May 2028 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP kickoff: security acceptance runbook + target close dates

Folks — forwarding Finovo’s reply. Key asks:

- Confirm subprocessors list and whether any infra is APAC-located (Aaron asked).
- Clarify our recommended retention windows (we usually propose: 30 days request payload, 12 months anonymized logs; option for configurable retention per-customer).
- Legal: prepare a DPA prefill we can send to Jane tomorrow to speed the redline.

I recommend we pre-fill the SIG file with our baseline answers so Aaron has something to review — reduces back-and-forth. Sean, any objections to proposing a 30-day default for full payloads (with contract carveout to extend per Finovo request)?

—Stephanie

On Wed, May 2, 2028 at 10:03 AM Finovo Security <security@finovo.com> wrote:
> Hi Stephanie,
> 
> Thanks for the MAP and the SOC 2 report...

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 May 2028 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP kickoff: security acceptance runbook + target close dates

Thanks — agree we should prefill SIG. On retention: our standard commercial default is 30 days for PII-containing request payloads (opt-in to 90/365 with justification and pricing delta), and 12 months for aggregated operational logs (truncated). We can offer a retention profile table in the MAP showing trade-offs + cost estimate.

Action items for us:
- Karthik: prepare subprocessors list and a short note on geographic footprint (APAC presence?).
- Monica: draft a DPA prefill (standard Redwood template) and upload to Drive so Jane can start redlines.
- Stephanie: prefill SIG baseline and mark questions we need Finovo to confirm.

I’ll block 30 minutes on May 7 to walk through the MAP with Finovo security.

—Sean

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 14:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: security acceptance runbook + target close dates

Stephanie — subprocessors list below and short notes:

- Cloud infra: Redwood Compute (contracted AWS us-west-2) — no APAC infra for customer workloads by default.
- Model hosting & optimizations: Redwood Inference Layer — uses pooled GPU hosts in us-west-2 and eu-west-1; customers can opt for dedicated pools (can be provisioned in APAC on request but requires a dedicated deployment).
- Analytics & metrics: Third-party analytics (Redwood Metrics) — processes aggregated telemetry only.
- Monitoring: Pager/Radar (third-party) — only alert metadata, no request payloads.

We will provide a signed subprocessors list and a short blurb about where customer data may traverse. I’ll upload the list to the Drive link for the MAP.

—Karthik

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@finovo.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, security@finovo.com
Cc: legal@finovo.com, aaron.liu@finovo.com
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: security acceptance runbook + target close dates

Hi Stephanie — appreciate the quick turnaround and the prefilled items. A few short decisions from our side:

- Aaron confirms he’ll take the SIG answers and coordinate the evidence handoff; target EOD May 5 for completed SIG (we received your prefill earlier and used that to accelerate).
- Legal completed a quick pass on the DPA prefill; we uploaded redlines to the Drive. Can Redwood confirm acceptance of the retention carveout (30 days payload default with option to extend) and the subprocessors list?
- Procurement: we need DocuSign envelope for the DPA once redlines are agreed; target to have DPA signed by May 16 to keep the original procurement window.

Next steps: we’ll review Redwood’s subprocessor text and sign off (or raise objections) by May 11. If all good, we proceed to DPA exchange and DocuSign.

Thanks,
Jane
Procurement | Finovo Bank
(jane.doe@finovo.com)
